positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Designed, tested, implemented, and maintained internal and customer facing web applications based on meetings with stakeholders and managers.   Some projects include: ticket/flag management system, automated product ranking system, and invoicing system.

positions.title: Web Portal and Communications Interface Manager
positions.description:
- Web interface design 
- Proficient with PHP, HTML5, CSS3 (SASS, Compass), JavaScript, JQuery, AJAX
- Knowledge of OOP and design patterns, especially interfaces and adapters
- Font and Back-end Web Development using MAMP
- MVC experience with Laravel through Laravel Homestead 
- Email design and creation
- Sales and Marketing analytics using Google Adwords, Google Analytics, and Authorize.net APIs as well as information from our own data stores.
- Virtual server (CentOS 7.1) configuration with Vagrant and VIrtualBox.

positions.title: Intern Web Developer
positions.description: Designed and implemented dynamic landing pages for multiple states in a nationwide marketing campaign using Balsamiq, Omnigraffle, Adobe Photoshop, PHP, MYSQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and JQuery.

positions.title: Aviation Support Equipment Refrigeration Technician/Electrician (MOS 6073)
positions.description: 5 years troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining mobile generators, air conditioners, and various aviation support equipment sometimes including hydraulic components.
